description: An extensionId sized so the encoded line is exactly 1048576 octets — exactly IPC_MAX_LINE_BYTES — is accepted: the limit is inclusive. The implementation checks byte length with a strict >, so a binding that instead uses >= would reject this line and still pass every other case in the corpus, since line-too-long-rejected.json only pins the one-octet-over side. Both event.extensionId and expect.line are generated (repeat/concat) rather than inlined, mirroring docs/spec/conformance/v1/framing/cases/frame-exactly-at-limit.json for the identical limit.
